vo.en: You are being watched right now.

visual.description: A close-up of a man's eyes intensely reflecting the blue light of a smartphone screen in a dark room.

vo.en: Look at the top corner of your phone. Is there a tiny orange or green dot?

visual.description: Macro shot of a smartphone's top notch area showing a glowing green privacy indicator.

vo.en: That isn't just a design choice. It means an app is actively using your camera or microphone without you knowing.

visual.description: A dark silhouette of a hand holding a phone, with a digital camera aperture icon overlay.

vo.en: But here is the creepy part. Those dots only catch the basic apps.

visual.description: A mysterious man wearing a hoodie typing rapidly on a laptop in a dimly lit office.

vo.en: Swipe down your control center and look for the screen mirroring icon immediately.

visual.description: A hand swiping down on a smartphone screen to reveal the control panel settings interface.

vo.en: If you didn't turn it on and it's glowing or showing a weird device name, someone could be viewing your screen.

visual.description: A security camera lens rotating slowly, reflecting a digital screen in its glass.

vo.en: Reset your privacy settings and subscribe to stay protected. Comment CLEAN if you're safe, which is exactly why

visual.description: A glowing digital shield icon appearing on a screen, symbolizing a secure connection.
